purpose: Acquisition authority and coverage evidence for Texas physical-grid classes. This ledger records source availability, not an inventory of physical assets and not statewide completeness.
truth_boundary: A source marked unavailable, restricted, denied, or candidate closes only that acquisition attempt. It neither changes the physical class to complete nor permits inferred assets, geometry, terminals, or connectivity.

geography.name: Texas
geography.boundary_limit: The 254 counties bound geographic selection only. They are not an asset-count denominator.

prohibited_inference: Do not create an asset, route, terminal, edge, voltage, owner, or geometry from imagery, proximity, street data, or a synthetic electrical case.
A line endpoint name is not an electrical terminal edge unless the source explicitly supplies an identified terminal-to-terminal relation.
ACTIVSg2000 remains synthetic and is never evidence of a real Texas asset or connection.
truth_policy.coverage_policy: A source record count is only a denominator for that source selection when the source explicitly defines that selection as complete. Otherwise denominator is null and the coverage state must remain partial, unknown, unavailable, or restricted.

source_records.coverage_limit: National annual survey of plants/generators with combined nameplate capacity of 1 MW or greater; it does not inventory distribution, transmission, substations, physical load, or electrical connectivity.
source_records.recommended_use: Authoritative source for a versioned Texas generation/storage artifact once a downloader writes the exact checksum and row counts.
source_records.geometry_accuracy_basis: Reported plant coordinates in the Plant schedule; a point is a plant location, not an interconnection point or site boundary.

source_records.spatial_extent: National annual survey; Texas rows are selected by state field, not by geometry
source_records.acquisition_condition: Record the exact artifact sha256, form year, row counts and retrieved_at before any generation artifact is derived; the generation_inventory track owns that acquisition.

texas_envelope.provenance: total_bounds of the 254 STATEFP=48 polygons in Census TIGER/Line 2024 tl_2024_us_county.zip (sha256 04e668d3502757c837c13444730547cd967f28a2c49aeffb873d1792ab2cb97b, the same artifact receipted in data/sources/texas-tiger-2024.json), read with geopandas on 2026-09-06.
texas_envelope.envelope_limit: A rectangle around Texas. It intersects neighbouring-state features and clips nothing to the state boundary, so a count taken through it is never a Texas count or a denominator.

physical_class_coverage.scope: Texas, ERCOT DC ties and the ERCOT/Eastern-Interconnection and ERCOT/WECC seams
physical_class_coverage.reason: 2WKG-443 asks for ERCOT seams and interties where evidence supports them. No source audited for this ledger supplies identified intertie or seam assets with native geometry and a terminal relation: the archived HIFLD layer carries no intertie classification, its SUB_1/SUB_2 endpoint names are often UNKNOWN or TAP, and the restricted Texas wind service was never observed. The count of source-backed interties for this audit is therefore unknown, not zero, and must not be inferred from line endpoints, map adjacency or ACTIVSg2000.
